---
title: "Does it meet the 2 s flight-time target with the cosmetics removed?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0
PROBE_POOL = 200.0
PROBE_SPENT = 177.1

import aerosandbox as asb
import aerosandbox.numpy as np

plane = get_airplane()
mass, cg = get_mass_properties(plane)
required_cg = get_cg_x(plane)

ballast_mass = mass * (cg[0] - required_cg) / (required_cg - 0)
total_mass = mass + max(0, ballast_mass)
mg = total_mass * 9.81

# 1. Untrimmed performance (Theoretical Maximum Flight Time)
opt = asb.Opti()
v = opt.variable(init_guess=4.0, lower_bound=1.0, upper_bound=20.0)
alpha = opt.variable(init_guess=5.0, lower_bound=-10.0, upper_bound=20.0)

aero_untrimmed = asb.AeroBuildup(
    airplane=plane,
    op_point=asb.OperatingPoint(velocity=v, alpha=alpha),
).run()

L = aero_untrimmed["L"]
D = aero_untrimmed["D"]
gamma = np.arctan(D / L)

opt.subject_to(L * np.cos(gamma) + D * np.sin(gamma) == mg)

sink_rate = v * np.sin(gamma)
opt.minimize(sink_rate)
sol = opt.solve(verbose=False)

untrimmed_time = 1.5 / float(sol.value(sink_rate))

# 2. Trimmed performance
plane_with_cg = asb.Airplane(
    name=plane.name,
    xyz_ref=[required_cg, 0, plane.xyz_ref[2]],
    wings=plane.wings,
    fuselages=plane.fuselages
)

incidences = np.linspace(-30, 0, 31)
trimmed_times = []

for inc in incidences:
    p2 = apply_incidence(plane_with_cg, inc)
    alpha_trim = get_trim_alpha(p2, bracket=[-20, 80])
    
    if np.isnan(alpha_trim):
        trimmed_times.append(0.0)
        continue
        
    v_trim, ld_trim, sink_trim = get_trimmed_flight_state(p2, total_mass, alpha_trim)
    if np.isnan(sink_trim):
        trimmed_times.append(0.0)
    else:
        trimmed_times.append(1.5 / sink_trim)

best_trimmed_time = np.max(trimmed_times)
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"No, {best_trimmed_time:.2f} s"`]{.hero-value}
[Best trimmed flight time from 1.5 m]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** It cannot fly at all. While the airframe has a theoretical, untrimmed flight time of [`{python} f"{untrimmed_time:.2f}"`]{.key} s, trimming it is impossible for positive lift. Removing the forward-mounted nacelles shifted the fuselage's pitching moment to be strongly nose-down. Because the required center of gravity sits slightly ahead of the wing's aerodynamic center, positive lift from the wing also produces a nose-down moment. With no way to generate a pitch-up moment, the aircraft can only trim at negative lift coefficients.
